name: Ryan Hershey
background: Ryan Hershey of Albany County won the 2026 Republican primary for county coroner and lost the November 2026 general election. The Laramie Reporter reported the results as 5,311 votes (42%) to Sally King's 7,257 (58%). No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the official Albany County election results or the other public records reviewed for this Profile.
